# Pickl.AI

> > Pickl.AI is a comprehensive data science certification platform offering professional courses, hands-on projects, and industry-recognized training by practicing data scientists.

Pickl.AI provides structured data science and machine learning certification programs designed for career advancement and skill development. Founded by industry experts including Atul Prakash and team, the platform combines theoretical knowledge with practical, hands-on projects and real-world case studies.

## Key Topics

- Data Science Certification
- Machine Learning Courses
- Professional Certification Programs
- Hands-on Projects
- Career Growth
- Self-paced Learning
- Industry Case Studies
- Skill Development
- Data Science Training
- Career Advancement
- Professional Development
- Skills Training
- Course Catalog
- TransOrg Analytics

## Core Offerings

- [Professional Data Science Certification by Pickl.AI](https://www.pickl.ai): Pickl.AI homepage: comprehensive data science certification platform by practicing data scientists
- [Browse Pickl.AI for the best Data Science courses](https://www.pickl.ai/courses-listing): Course catalog showcasing data science certification programs for all skill levels
- [E-books - Browse Data Science E-books | Pickl.AI](https://www.pickl.ai/ebooks): E-book library with data science, machine learning, and statistics resources
